summary: N-type metal gate TiAlC film was grown by thermal atomic layer deposition (ALD) using titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4) and triethylaluminum (TEA) as precursors. The effective workfunction can be tuned from 4.46 eV to 4.24 eV by adjusting the growth temperature and film thickness. The TiAlC film is a promising gate metal candidate for FinFET devices at the 22 nm technology node and beyond.
